title: Vinnie Colaiuta (Robyn Flans, Modern Drummer, October 1993)
notes: Seven Days: 'I phrased it by playing over the bar line, so the hi-hat pattern resolves every two bars. That smoothes it out and gives it a regularity that 4/4 has.' Love Is Stronger Than Justice: 'that over-the-bar ride cymbal, where the ride cymbal is playing sort of quarter notes'. Saint Augustine in Hell: 'The same kind of thing. These patterns in seven are very similar.' Kit: Yamaha Maple Custom, Zildjian. Read through a page summariser, quotes extracted.

title: Vinnie Colaiuta (Robyn Flans, Modern Drummer, 1982)
notes: Gary Chaffee at Berklee, 'applying polyrhythms to the drumset'; Zappa: 'Play this against that, or play five against four'; Keep It Greasey 'one part where the actual time signature is 19/16 ... another part in 21. It was all one live take'. Read through a summariser.

title: Vinnie Colaiuta (Robyn Flans, Modern Drummer, May 1987)
notes: Tony Williams 'opened up a whole new world of rhythmic conceptual understanding'; 'DeJohnette is still hip'. Read through a summariser.

title: Interview (Rick Mattingly, Percussive Notes, 1995)
notes: Odd time: 'the same consideration of feel', 'not necessarily defining the downbeats in every bar'; Chaffee; Elvin 'so unbelievably hip', Cobham 'avoiding downbeats', Roy Haynes 'He danced on the drums'. Read through a summariser.

title: Interview (Berklee Press, 2001)
notes: 5/4 grouped 'two and three versus three and two'; Love Is Stronger Than Justice's verses in seven, the chorus a country two-beat. Read through a summariser.

title: Vinnie Colaiuta (Mike Haid, Modern Drummer, March 2021)
notes: Mitch Mitchell with Hendrix: 'I would get excited and be inspired by it.' Read through a summariser.

title: Vinnie Colaiuta - Wikipedia
notes: Vincent Peter Colaiuta, born 5 February 1956, Brownsville, Pennsylvania; Zappa 1978-81; Joni Mitchell; Sting from 1990; Jeff Beck; Jing Chi; Modern Drummer Hall of Fame 1996.

title: Seven Days (Sting song) - Wikipedia
notes: Cites Steve Ley (Online Drummer, 2015): 5/8 at 184 eighths, the hat accents on the odd beats in the first bar and the even in the second, the kick on 1 and the snare on 4; and Matthew Rait (PhD, York, 2019): 'rhythmic displacement ... implying a duple rhythmic organization'. Ley and Rait not read directly.

title: Legendäre Drummer & Grooves #5: Vinnie Colaiuta (Harry Bum Tschak, bonedo.de, 17 May 2018)
notes: Saint Augustine in Hell in 7/8: the bell accents on eighths 1, 3, 5 and 7 in the first bar and 2, 4 and 6 in the second. Its fill: snare accents in sextuplets. The text and notation description read; the PDF not.

title: Sting "I Hung My Head" auf dem Schlagzeug lernen (Simon Schröder, bonedo.de, 6 April 2026)
notes: 9/8 (2+3+2+2): the hat in a cell across the bar line, bell quarters over hat eighths with quarter accents; 'very precise and dry', rimshot backbeats; credits him. The text read; the notation not.

title: How To Play Love Is Stronger Than Justice Drums (Diego Cardini, The Drum Ninja, 8 January 2026)
notes: The verse in 7/8: hat sixteenths, the kick on 1, the 'and' of 4 and 6, the snare on 3 and 7; the chorus a shuffle. The text read; the PDF not.

title: Polyrhythmic Bass Drum Workout (Daniel Bédard, Modern Drummer, 30 November 2018)
notes: Stan Key (Jing Chi, 2002) at 4:23: 'a four-over-five polyrhythm' on the china 'while keeping a steady 4/4 beat with his other limbs'. Preview only; the lesson is paywalled.
